The '''Battle of Station 3''' was fought between the [[Disac pirates|Disac]] and [[Ghilron pirates]] who were rival groups operating in the region along the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. The battle caused significant damage to [[Station 3]].<ref name="SotSR" />
